description: Counter-CTR end-to-end isolation (E12 / A3). Categorical-ONLY feature matrix (two columns, cardinality 6 and 5, zero float columns) so upstream float-quantization nondeterminism is structurally excluded. one_hot_max_size=1 routes both columns to the CTR path. simple_ctr=Counter with combinations_ctr=[] and max_ctr_complexity=1 isolates the simple Counter type: its numerator is the WHOLE-SET bucket total (each document's own row included) and its denominator is the constant MAX bucket total, so unlike every prefix type it is permutation-INdependent. NEVER regenerated in CI.

npy_schema.X_cat.npy: [N,2] int32 — categorical codes (stringified A4 form on the Rust side)

note: FROZEN. Generated once by this directory's own gen_fixtures.py and NEVER regenerated in CI. Regenerating invalidates the <=1e-5 gate.
